commit_message:
wait_and_reap on Windows: read the tree, kill the survivors (#26)

* wait_and_reap on Windows: read the tree, kill the survivors

descendants() reads the Windows process table (one Toolhelp snapshot;
a child created before its recorded parent is a recycled pid, not a
child), start_time() uses GetProcessTimes (None once exited), and
wait_and_reap watches the tree on Windows too and kills survivors with
taskkill /T. Windows-only tests in tests/test_windows_tree.py.

Closes #25

* Windows reaping: review fixes

- _kernel32 built once (lru_cache): a ctypes struct per call grew the
  pointer-type cache without bound (~1 GB/hour under the watcher).
- descendants visits each pid once (recorded parents can cycle).
- Survivors are terminated by handle after their start time is checked
  on that handle; no taskkill /T, which follows recycled parent pids.
- Windows test: gone means a different start time (pids are reused
  quickly); the worker's start time is read while it runs.
